why: The hearth stone's call to the party aimed at `anchor/hearth` itself, the cell the lit campfire stands on, instead of the floor two cells east of it. A party teleport puts its first member on the mark's own cell, and a campfire's cell hurts a body that stands in it, so there is no seat for every member: the build refuses it, naming the mark and its cell, and asks for open floor with room for four players side by side. It declares no unit: the party subject is a surface the primary binds.
